claim: DISGENET is an external platform for gene-disease and disease-genomics knowledge, including NLP-supported disease genomics data and gene-disease associations.
future_grounding_route: Specific DISGENET MS gene-disease associations can be queued as external-verifiable hypotheses and tested against project-held genetics/transcriptomics before use.
project_use: Competitor/source cataloging and future hypothesis queueing.
unique_knowledge_lacks_in_repo: Disease-genomics/gene-disease association knowledgebase integrating curated and text-mined evidence.
why_unverifiable: The project cannot rerun DISGENET's external curation, NLP extraction, scoring, and licensing-dependent data integration.
